title: Physiological Ecology of Animals
description:
Prerequisite: BSCI361; or students who have taken courses with comparable content may contact the department; or permission of instructor.
Credit only granted for: MEES498E, MEES698E, MEES432, or MEES632.
Formerly: MEES498E. An examination of the influence of environmental constrains on animal function and energetic efficiency in the context of abiotic conditions in the habitats occupied by individuals.
